title: trim removes Unicode white space and chomp one line terminator
purpose: Whitespace handling follows Go strings.TrimSpace; chomp removes one trailing CRLF or LF.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-033): trim() removes leading/trailing Unicode White_Space like Go strings.TrimSpace (oracle: go1.26.1 — tab, LF, CR, space, U+00A0, U+2003, U+3000, U+2028 removed; U+200B is not white space); chomp() removes exactly one trailing CRLF or LF and leaves a lone CR.
